summary_5_lines: City Bakers is a bakery on Station Road, Larkana (near KFC / Bukhari Shopping Centre), rated 4.2 from 1,465 Google reviews, phone +92 74 404 2488, famous for its plain cake and premium nut cake (cashew, almond, walnut, cherry), with chocolate cake, pastries, biscuits and sweets.
Larkana's most-reviewed bakery with no own website — only directory listings — and a fresh-hunt find in a new city for the lane.
Editorial magazine in warm paper + deep plum + muted gold, Josefin Sans display with PT Serif body — masthead hero with dateline, standfirst and a full-bleed plain-cake photo band.
Typographic cake board with dotted leaders, plum nut-cake feature band, marquee strip, lightbox gallery, honest 'Good to Know' notes, FAQ accordion, map + call-ahead hours card.
Could not be verified: opening hours (not published anywhere — call-ahead note only), prices ('Prices on request' once), founding year (none claimed), delivery/WhatsApp (stated as unverified).
